source: The advice term of the network leak bound as registered caps, not honest traces' lengths. The bound counts the advices the registered codec admits: at most 2^c strings are charged c bits or fewer (Kraft; the premise hAs of EncardAccSeqsSampledLe, Security/Definitions/NetworkCertifier/Guarantees/SampledCharge.lean), and the codec and its cap are registered before the first window, with advice over the cap refused (certifier PROTOCOL.md, A7; the compile slice proves each window's charge at most c_w). An adversarial prover picks any advice up to c_w, so each line is c_w times the scope's 600 s machine-windows, i.e. the cap a request times the scope's requests. code_v1's lengths are data-dependent (an adaptive arithmetic code: KT estimates over the decisions' runs with counts carried across windows from the book's priors, Exp-Golomb-binned counts and values, self-delimiting segments), so the card charges the cap, never the mean. An honest window above its cap is refused (completeness, not soundness); each line's source gives the condition under which honest windows fit and the share of traced windows that exceed it. Traced windows are 60 s and hold at most 1,000 requests, so each is scaled to a 600 s window by its bits a request; a 600 s window averages ten of them. Two regimes charge 0 bits and have no line on a log axis: batch-invariant Definitions, and certified ticks (the KV pool in the circuit, and each step admitting exactly the requests whose network-certifier release bucket closed by a logical clock that advances a registered tick a step, so every batch composition is a function of certified data and nothing is sent; neither is built, and it costs 2-4% of throughput on a stationary host in a simulation of vLLM's scheduler on the corpus traces). Of today's 135,918 charged bits over the 32 traced windows, 79% are hit shortfalls (removed by the KV pool in the circuit) and 21% are timing (open-step decisions 17%, order entries 3%, removed only by certified ticks). The 3-bit cap of the card it supersedes (saturated, any order, today's code_v1: 22 of 32 traced windows (69%) over) has no line: it sits a factor 2 below the 6-bit line. Not measured on GLM-5.3: the charges are vLLM d9105ea80's scheduler serving Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B on the RTX PRO 6000 (MRV2), carried over. This card supersedes art:535758cbede95411c6dcd2ff4b2b7bd6c1f638edbf914e6136e992dccdeac19e (lines 0.1, 3, 40 bits and 8 kbit a request, all under today's code_v1), which superseded art:f09f588b6442ef251890e7157398f1668e52a21f09e409b05f293534c4767a24, whose 0.008 and 0.33 bit/request lines were ENC-REPLAY's residual under egress-tell contexts, which the registered codec does not have: under code_v1 they exceed 31 of 32 traced windows (97%) and 30 of 32 traced windows (94%), and its 2.2 and 5.5k lines 23 of 32 traced windows (72%) and 19 of 49 traced windows (39%). Requests: figure1.scopes at cursor/proofs-spotfig-8216 93eea67d14 on the GLM-5.3 workload card, 4,500 tokens a request at 4.52e+14 FLOP, MFU 0.4 on the H200's dense FP8 peak: 2.07e+16 requests a world-year and 5.522e+12 a datacenter-year (100,000 GPUs), 8,404 requests a 600 s machine-window. Advice v1's table: art:0f5f23d498a7f042fcf2a638d9a1500afbc916a4498569666957754415428c30; v0's per-window bits: art:468c033980f026bd79f515b8dd6d7be9f7bcccef002e5de254185870571d6fa3, art:7b475cd238ad9f008c8a70937e06036bf98848559a45474a069e54276b8c0772, art:cddd5efa658f1f0fa6bfd40d94865b1dc8bde8cda3208a70a1e45d50af9b3033.

lines.label: Advice cap 0.1 bit/req (saturated, release order)
lines.source: A registered cap of 0.1 bits a request, c_w = 840 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. Honest windows fit when the engine is saturated (a waiting queue at every step) and admits in the certified release order (serve-openai --admit release-order, no order entries), with the KV pool's eviction derived in the circuit (no hit shortfalls sent): every heavy window, sync or async, 0.07-0.18. Under today's code_v1, which sends the hits, only seeded heavy fits (0.074). Exceeding it: 21 of 32 traced windows (66%) with the hits and the order entries removed of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w; 30 of 32 (94%) as sent today.

lines.label: Advice cap 6 bits/req (KV pool in circuit)
lines.source: A registered cap of 6 bits a request, c_w = 50,424 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. The KV pool in the circuit: the replay's LRU block pool (CacheStep_v2, CompileSlice_v3; at session scale offline memory checking, designed, not built) derives every prefix-cache hit, so none is sent, and what is left is the timing: the open-step decisions and the order entries. Every traced window fits: heavy 0.07-1.77, small KV 0.08-1.50, chunked 1.98-2.08, medium 3.30-3.42, light 3.42-5.93 bits a request. A cap of 3 bits leaves 12 of 32 over (every light and medium window). Exceeding it: 0 of 32 traced windows (0%) with the hits removed of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.

lines.label: Advice cap 40 bits/req (today)
lines.source: A registered cap of 40 bits a request, c_w = 336,160 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. Today's code_v1, which sends each prefix-cache hit past the no-eviction bound as its shortfall (79% of the 32 windows' 135,918 bits): every traced window fits, the small-KV ones included (at most 30.3, 315 preemptions at 8,192 KV tokens). Exceeding it: 0 of 32 traced windows (0%) of code_v1 (Advice v1, held-out book: each trace's book fit on the other 15), 32 windows of 60 s over 16 Llama-3.2-1B traces, a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.

lines.label: Advice cap 8 kbit/req (raw schedule)
lines.source: A registered cap of 8000 bits a request, c_w = 67,232,000 bits a 600 s window of 8,404 GLM-5.3 requests; the line is c_w times the scope's windows, the most any accepted advice is charged. The raw schedule charged as is, without the scheduler replayed in the circuit: v0 step records are 5.18-5.86 kbit a request per trace; the window over the cap is seeded light's tail (47 arrivals), and 3 of 49 (6%) exceed it on I1 v0 bits, an upper bound on the step records. Exceeding it: 1 of 49 traced windows (2%) of v0 step records, 49 windows of 60 s over 19 Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B traces, each window's step records estimated as its I1 v0 bits times its trace's step-record share (80-84%), a window with arrivals by its bits a request, one without held to c_w.
